home.title: KaramSetu | Trusted Local Workers Near You
home.hero_title: Hire nearby workers for everyday jobs, urgent repairs, and growing businesses.
home.hero_text: From electricians and plumbers to painters, drivers, and farm helpers, KaramSetu helps you discover dependable local workers with clear pricing, location visibility, and easy booking.
home.card_verified_text: Discover workers with reviews, verified profiles, and service details.
home.card_nearby_text: Search by service, distance, budget, and who is available today.
home.card_simple_text: Browse services, compare workers, and move from discovery to contact quickly.
home.how_title: From search to service in a few easy steps
home.step1_text: Start by browsing popular jobs like electrical work, plumbing, painting, cleaning, transport, and more.
home.step2_text: Use location, budget, rating, and availability to find the right worker for the job.
home.step3_text: Review skills, service area, availability, languages, and customer feedback before reaching out.
home.step4_text: Workers and businesses can create profiles so the right opportunities show up quicker.
home.get_started_title: Choose what you want to do today
home.browse_services_text: See the kinds of services available in your area.
home.find_workers_text: Compare local workers and choose the right person for your task.
home.join_as_text: Set up your account and start getting discovered or hiring faster.
home.footer_text: Trusted local help, closer to home.
